name: happy
description: recorded 2026-10-27 against api.voygr.tech: GET /skills. Public catalog data: the three runnable PlaceCall skills.

body.title: Cancel Booking
body.description: Place a phone call to a venue to cancel a reservation stored under ``booking_id``. Works only for bookings made before 2026-10-05: the API has stored no bookings since, so no newer ``booking_id`` exists. Not recommended for new integrations. The agent identifies the reservation to staff by name, date and party size, requests cancellation, and confirms it. ``ask_user`` is fired only if staff asks for something not on file.

body.title: Concierge — info, follow-up, issue resolution
body.description: Place a phone call to ask a question, collect information, or calmly report a problem and request resolution. NOT for bookings or cancellations — use ``restaurant-reservation`` / ``cancel-booking`` for those. The pre-call analyzer surfaces missing required information as a structured 422 — collect from your user, populate ``pre_filled_slots``, and resubmit.

body.title: Restaurant Reservation
body.description: Place a phone call to a restaurant and book a table on behalf of an end user. The voice agent introduces itself, requests the table, dictates the contact phone (spelled-out for accuracy), and confirms the reservation. ``ask_user`` is fired if staff requires info not provided in the input (deposit, surname, allergy specifics).
